identity.description: Grain (grain.com) is an AI meeting recorder and notes product. Its public API is documented at developers.grain.com and served from api.grain.com.
identity.identity_notes: Support article and developer docs both describe the Grain API for meeting recordings. The 'grain.com (meeting notes)' hint matches. Some third-party listings have similar names, but these pages are Grain's own.

auth.oauth_flows: Confirmed for the official MCP server only (OAuth 2.1 with Dynamic Client Registration, per Scalekit's listing of Grain's MCP). The REST API accepting OAuth2 access tokens is reported only by Jentic, a secondary source, and is unverified.
auth.scopes_notes: Personal tokens act as the user with that user's Grain permissions. Workspace tokens grant access to all workspace data. No scope list was retrieved.

access.production_restrictions: Not established. Personal tokens are self-issued. Workspace tokens need a workspace admin and a Business or Enterprise plan. Public app/OAuth listing requirements were not checked.

api.rate_limits: A Rate Limits page exists at developers.grain.com but its values were not retrieved.
api.limitations: Only the token-info endpoint was seen directly. Endpoint reference, Hooks and Authentication pages returned HTTP 403 to my fetch. Requests require Authorization and Public-Api-Version headers (example version 2026-10-01). Third-party listings describe recording, highlight and story webhook events, but these were not verified on Grain's pages. v1 (beta) reportedly sunset Sept 2026 (search snippet only).
